items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: the first album that I really memorized everything on was Stan Getz, Astrud Gilberto and “Desifinado”

ctx.x: But we just started developing this record collection. My mother would buy them when she saw them and I would buy them when I saw them and I would — oh later on we got this Sears Silvertone stereo, which was the stereo man, it was so cool. And I would lay

down in front of this thing and just lift the arm up, when you still had the arm on the record player, and I would put the record on and listen to it over and over and over again, just the one side. And I would just lay on the floor between the two speakers. And I would sort of get into trance, didn’t even realize what I was doing to myself but I was programming my computer with licks and I could scat everything that I heard so I was actually scatting them out loud so basically I was working on my vocal chops,…
So you were learning his solos?
